target.value: Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) Targets one creature plus one additional creature per four levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

description.summary: You instill courage in the subject, granting it a +4 morale bonus against fear effects for 10 minutes.
description.value: You instill courage in the subject, granting it a +4 morale bonus against fear effects for 10 minutes. If the subject is under the influence of a fear effect when receiving the song, that effect is suppressed for the duration of the song.
